secrets.name: SESSION_SECRET
secrets.description: Signing secret for express-session cookies. A development placeholder is generated automatically; replace with a strong 32+ char value for any real use.

secrets.name: DISCORD_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Discord OAuth2 client ID from the Discord Developer Portal (General Settings page). Required for Discord sign-in to work.

secrets.name: DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.description: Discord OAuth2 client secret from the Discord Developer Portal (General Settings page). Required for Discord sign-in to work.

secrets.name: DISCORD_REDIRECT_URI
secrets.description: OAuth2 redirect URI. For the preview, use https://3000-${BASE44_PUBLIC_HOST_SUFFIX}/auth/discord/callback. Must be added to the Discord app's OAuth2 Redirects list.

secrets.name: HORICHAN_API_BASE_URL
secrets.description: Base URL of the Horichan bot's read-only management API (v1). Optional; the adapter stays fail-closed when unset.

secrets.name: HORICHAN_API_TOKEN
secrets.description: Shared bearer token for the Horichan API (at least 32 characters). Must match the token configured in the bot. Optional.
